title: Private 5BR/3.5BA Home on 30A with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Blue Bungalow, a 3BR, 3BA beachside private home on 30A, steps from the beach, with a gorgeous kitchen, outdoor grill, and a private pool. Sleeps 16.
description_expanded: Come experience a vacation steps from the beach with a level of privacy rarely found along 30A. What makes it even better is your very own private pool.This casually elegant, custom-built beach cottage offers comfortable, open concept living complete with hardwood floors and a stone fireplace under a large TV. The gorgeous kitchen includes a walk-in pantry and a 5-burner gas stove. The dining area is furnished with an oversized table with seating for 12 and additional seating at the kitchen island.An elegant master suite is located on the 1st floor plus a convenient half bath and laundry room. Easily accommodating multiple families, upstairs are 4 bedrooms plus built-in hall bunks. From the 2nd floor you'll find access to an observation tower above the trees with spectacular views of the Gulf and Eastern Lake.The house offers 2 large screened-in porches. The front porch is nestled in the shadow of the live oaks. There is an expansive back porch overlooking the pool and the privacy fence creates a hidden oasis. The driveway and separate circular drive provide ample parking for multiple cars.The house is approximately 250 yards from the beach access and access to Eastern Lake for kayaking, fishing, and paddle boarding. And, you'll be in close proximity to restaurants and shopping around the Seagrove area.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.--2nd Floor, Landing: Twin-over-twin built-in bunks2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: 2 queen beds, TV.2nd Floor, Bedroom 5: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, TV.Shared hallway bathroom features a tub/shower combo.Beach Access:Head south on Gulf Drive; you can take this road until it ends at Eastern Lake Beach Access or continue further west on Eastern Lake Road where you'll find the Ramsgate Beach Access.Distance: .1 or .3 miles | Time: 3 or 6 minutes walkingSeagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer! Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs right near the neighborhood. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy exploring the boutique shops, fabulous restaurants, and beautiful state parks in each of these communities.Your stay at Blue Bungalow comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 7 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
